About

Cross-domain builder,
from models to interfaces.

I'm a fourth-year B.Tech student in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at Aditya University, Surampalem, working across machine learning, deep learning, generative AI and full-stack MERN development. I like taking a system from a raw dataset to a working product people can actually use.

Alongside coursework, I've built a healthcare disease-prediction system, an end-to-end Generative AI platform integrating Google's Gemini APIs, and several full-stack web apps. I've also served as Class Representative since first year — coordinating between faculty and students, which sharpened the mentoring and communication skills I now bring to a Trainer Intern role.
